sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。

related.title: MPTCP：跨子流資料序號與重複交付
related.titleEn: MPTCP: cross-subflow data sequence and duplicate delivery
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：第5項研究的可複查條件：接受時間差計算與gate標記；實際RACK還須處理RTT、重傳歧義及規範條件。 交接時須能核對：交付 rack-time.csv、兩種窗口結果及晚到反例。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 review criterion: Accept arithmetic and gate labels only; real RACK also handles RTT, retransmission ambiguity and protocol conditions. Handover must also reconcile: Deliver rack-time.csv, both window outcomes and a late-arrival counterexample.
related.difference: 建立subflow seq到DSN映射與半開區間，按DSN聯集計算應用唯一資料量。
related.differenceEn: Map subflow sequence to DSN intervals and count unique application bytes by DSN union.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
RACK利用已確認資料的傳送時間推論遺失；重排序窗口避免把所有晚到封包當遺失。
教學基準：12-5 = 7 ms margin；對照：12-15 = -3 ms margin。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。

MPTCP在子流TCP序號之外維持資料序號映射；重新注入資料不能重複交付應用。
教學基準：6000+6000-2000 = 10000 unique B；對照：6000+6000 = 12000 unique B。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
RACK uses transmission times of acknowledged data to infer loss; a reordering window prevents treating every late packet as lost.
Teaching baseline: 12-5 = 7 ms margin; comparison: 12-15 = -3 ms margin. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.

MPTCP maintains data-sequence mappings beyond subflow TCP sequence numbers; reinjected data must not be delivered twice.
Teaching baseline: 6000+6000-2000 = 10000 unique B; comparison: 6000+6000 = 12000 unique B. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: stale-while-revalidate：回應延遲與背景更新
related.titleEn: stale-while-revalidate: response latency and background refresh

Handover must also reconcile: Deliver rack-time.csv, both window outcomes and a late-arrival counterexample.
related.difference: 將fresh、可背景刷新stale、超出容許三種狀態分開，不把後兩者都當快取成功。
related.differenceEn: Separate fresh, stale-with-background-refresh and beyond-allowance states rather than treating both latter cases as ordinary hits.
